chain.label: Air stair door design vulnerable to jamming from deformation
chain.trigger: the design and testing of the door did not account for minimal permanent deformation that could introduce slack into the door control system

chain.label: No on-airport ARFF staffing required for Quincy operation
chain.trigger: the truck at the airport was not staffed at the time of the accident because no air carrier aircraft with more than 30 passenger seats were landing or taking off

chain.label: King Air pilot likely not at peak alertness
chain.trigger: the accident occurred at 1701, a time often associated with fatigue...he was most likely not at his peak alertness at the time of the accident

chain.label: Cherokee pilot's limited flight experience
chain.trigger: the Cherokee pilot had accumulated only 80 hours of flight time, and his radio communications reflected his inexperience

chain.label: King Air occupants failed to monitor CTAF or scan for traffic
chain.trigger: the failure of the pilots in the King Air A90 to effectively monitor the common traffic advisory frequency or to properly scan for traffic

caused_by.evidence: he was most likely not at his peak alertness at the time of the accident

chain.label: Cherokee pilot's unnecessary radio response mistaken for the King Air
chain.trigger: seven six four six Juliet...holding...for departure on runway four...* on the uh, King Air

caused_by.evidence: his radio communications reflected his inexperience

chain.label: Beech 1900C crew misunderstood transmission as King Air's assurance to hold
chain.trigger: they mistook the Cherokee pilot's transmission...as a response from the King Air to their request for the King Air's intentions

caused_by.evidence: the captain's reply...made it clear that she believed she was communicating with the airplane that was to take off next on the runway

chain.label: King Air commences takeoff roll on runway 04
chain.trigger: resulting in their commencing a takeoff roll when the Beech 1900C (United Express flight 5925) was landing on an intersecting runway

caused_by.evidence: the failure...to effectively monitor the common traffic advisory frequency or to properly scan for traffic, resulting in their commencing a takeoff roll

chain.label: Beech 1900C and King Air collide at runway intersection
chain.trigger: the airplane collided with the King Air at the intersection of runways 13 and 04

caused_by.evidence: the King Air began its takeoff roll about 13 seconds before flight 5925 touched down
the pilots may have become less concerned about continuing to watch the King Air during their landing

chain.label: Air stair door could not be opened by rescuers
chain.trigger: the most likely reason that the air stair door could not be opened is that the accident caused deformation of the door/frame system and created slack in the door control cable

caused_by.evidence: the introduction of as little as 1/4 inch of slack in the cable could prevent the cams from fully rotating

chain.label: All 14 occupants of both airplanes die from smoke inhalation and thermal injuries
chain.trigger: the cause of death for the occupants of both airplanes was either carbon monoxide intoxication from inhalation of smoke and soot...or inhalation of products of combustion

caused_by.evidence: the speed with which the fire enveloped the King Air and the intensity of the fire precluded survivability for the occupants of the King Air
the occupants of the Beech 1900C did not escape because the air stair door could not be opened and the left overwing exit hatch was not opened
if on-airport ARFF protection had been required for this operation at Quincy Airport, lives might have been saved
